lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  by_contra hne
  rw [funext_iff] at hne
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.1 hne
  have hi : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have h0 : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (fun h => hx0 (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hpos⟩ : ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ, 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hi.continuousAt h0)
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  let u : Y → ℝ := fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have hu : (fun x => ⟪f x, φ x • f x₀⟫_ℝ) = u := funext fun x => inner_smul_right' _ _ _
  have hc : Continuous u := φ.continuous.mul hi
  have hnn : 0 ≤ u := fun x => by
    show 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
    by_cases h : φ x = 0
    · simp [h]
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hpos x (le_of_eq φ.support_eq (Function.mem_support.mpr h))).le
  have hI : ∫ x, u x ∂μ = 0 := by
    rw [← hu]
    exact hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  refine (ne_of_gt (integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero hc
      (hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.mul_right φ.hasCompactSupport))
      hnn (mul_ne_zero (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)).ne' h0.ne'))) hI
